svg.title: Exact bzip2 compression-ratio histograms for all 1--4-byte inputs
svg.desc: Eight panels. X is original size divided by compressed size, so higher is better. Y is occurrence count on a logarithmic scale. Every bit pattern is included at each byte length.
svg.text: X: original / compressed (higher is better) · Y: occurrences (log scale) · each input is an independent bzip2 stream
Exact over all 256^n inputs for each n = 1, 2, 3, 4. Payload excludes outer framing but retains codec-internal metadata.
